title: Replace CDN links with GitHub Pages; add missing report; modernize dictionary
description:
## Summary

The legacy `rsacdn.link` CDN is being retired. This repo now publishes via **GitHub Pages** (enabled on `main`, root). This PR repoints the dictionary **and report** references to Pages URLs, and adds the report HTML that the CDN was serving but which was missing from this repo.

## Changes

- **Repoint links (milestone files):** the `heart-catheterization_dictionary` (6 references) and `heart-report` (2 references) now point to `https://rstudio.github.io/academy-pinr-heart-catheterization/assets/<name>.html` instead of `rsacdn.link`.
- **Add the missing report:** `assets/heart-report.html` was referenced via the CDN but not present in the repo. Added the self-contained rendered report (no external asset dependencies).
- **Modernize the dictionary:** `assets/heart-catheterization_dictionary.qmd` was already Quarto `format: html`; added `embed-resources: true` and re-rendered for a guaranteed self-contained file.

## Verification

- `grep` confirms **no** `rsacdn`, `cerulean`, or `teachthis` references remain in any `.qmd` or `.html`.
- Dictionary re-rendered self-contained (no `_files/` sidecar); the added report HTML has no external asset references.
- GitHub Pages enabled and building; live dictionary + report URLs return HTTP 200.

> **Note:** the `heart-report.html` here is the existing self-contained rendered artifact (byte-identical to the source `heart-report.qmd`'s output). It was **not** re-rendered from source in this pass because the report requires the `survminer` R package, which is not installed in this environment. If you want it re-rendered from source, install `survival`/`survminer`/`tidyverse` and run `quarto render assets/heart-report.qmd` from the `assets/` directory.
